title: Termination Charge by Months in Force
content:
# Termination Charge by Months in Force

Charge grid of the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda for a waiver terminated after its lienholder reports the loan paid off or refinanced away. The termination charge is the amount deducted from the termination refund in the place of the cancellation fee. It turns on the tier's waive-on-payoff switch and on the termination's months in force, the whole calendar months from the sale date to the loan payoff date.

## Grid

| Waiver tier (waive-on-payoff switch) | 36 or more months in force | 24 to 35 months | Fewer than 24 months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler GAP Waiver 125 (off) | 15.00 | 30.00 | 50.00 (tier cancellation fee) |
| Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 (off) | 15.00 | 30.00 | 50.00 (tier cancellation fee) |
| Kessler GAP Commercial 130 (off) | 15.00 | 30.00 | 75.00 (tier cancellation fee) |
| Kessler GAP Waiver 150 (on) | Nothing | Nothing | Nothing |
| Kessler GAP Plus 150 (on) | Nothing | Nothing | Nothing |
| Kessler GAP Plus 175 (on) | Nothing | Nothing | Nothing |

Stated as a rule: where the switch is off and the months in force are 36 or more, the termination charge is 15.00; where the switch is off and the months in force are 24 to 35, it is 30.00; in every other case it is the tier's cancellation fee, or nothing where the switch is on.

The termination charge is deducted from the refund after the unused-share amount has been rounded half up to the cent.

**Counting months in force.** A whole calendar month counts each time the sale date's day of the month is reached; a payoff date on an earlier day of the month does not complete the month, and there is no month-end adjustment.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** A Kessler GAP Waiver 125 sold on the 9th of a month and paid off on the 9th of the month three years later has 36 months in force: 15.00. Paid off on the 8th of that month: 35 months, 30.00. Paid off 23 months after sale: the 50.00 tier fee.
